name: Aylo (formerly MindGeek)
description: Operator of major adult-content platforms including Pornhub, YouPorn, and RedTube, using third-party identity verification (Yoti) for content uploaders and various age-assurance methods for viewers depending on jurisdiction.
notes: Not a dedicated identity-verification vendor; included because it retained performers' identity documents and Social Security numbers collected through its verification process.

name: Serasa Experian (Brazil)
description: Brazilian subsidiary of global credit bureau Experian, providing credit scoring, identity verification, and KYC data products to Brazilian businesses.
notes: Experian disputes that its own systems were breached, but the leaked dataset closely resembled Serasa data categories and was widely attributed to the company in Brazilian reporting and litigation.

name: Buró de Crédito (Mexico)
description: Mexico's principal credit-reporting bureau, used by banks and lenders for identity verification and creditworthiness checks nationwide.
notes: Mexico's banking regulator CNBV was notified of a possible data exposure in 2022-2023; full scope and attribution remained publicly unconfirmed at initial reporting.

name: EguWallet
description: eIDAS 2.0-certified European Digital Identity Wallet developed by IT Eguilde SRL, allowing citizens to store and present ID cards, driving licences, diplomas, and qualified signatures from a mobile device.
notes: No confirmed public breach identified as of research date.
